evidence.notes: Third run, against the materiality revision. Reproduced the denial with a red test and read the code: signature-invalid, because the gateway rebuilt the verified argument map without memo while the holder signed over it; the note also states that closed-world would have rejected memo next. Fix: memo enters the single args map used for both PoP and constraint checking, is stored by the effect, and is named in transfer_constraints with RegexConstraint('^[\\x20-\\x7E]{0,140}$'). Recipient and amount are per-warrant parameters; no widening. Trusted root, clock tolerance, revocation mode, closed-world mode, TTL, and depth unchanged; residual risk stated as bounded opaque text with a note that forwarding it downstream would need its own review. This is the bounded-constraint shape for a kept value; no wildcard.
